[EN] The Price of Hubris
[ES] El precio de la soberbia
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy those plans any way you can. Talk to Tulutulu to descend into Azarel's Labyrinth.
[ES] Destruye esos planes como sea. Habla con Tulutulu para descender al laberinto de Azarel.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I will."
[ES] "Lo haré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to {@linkcreature:209#2000$$Tulutulu} to gain entrance to Azarel's Labyrinth Depths.
[ES] Habla con {@linkcreature:209#2000$$Tulutulu} para entrar en las profundidades del laberinto de Azarel.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can't believe I ate the whole plan."
[ES] "No puedo creer que me haya tragado el plan entero."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the centurion at the Advance Camp in Azarel's Labyrinth Depths and destroy the battle plans he carries.
[ES] Busca al centurión en el campamento avanzado de las profundidades del laberinto de Azarel y destruye los planes de batalla que lleva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
